status: prospective model diagnostic; no new vertical-force dataset consulted
source: results.json sensitivity cases; fractional weighting floor 0.03; R < 20 kpc
freeze: Reuse stored rotation fits; do not refit either model to vertical-force observations.

prospective_observable.name: vertical gravitational acceleration magnitude
prospective_observable.geometry: axisymmetric; measured from the Galactic midplane

illustrative_design.interpretation: Assumed total measurement error for experimental design only; not a published error bar or discovery significance.

decision_rule: Compare both frozen predictions with the measurement using its published likelihood and correlated systematics. If both fail, reconsider the shared assumptions rather than automatically adding parameters.
independence_caveat: McMillan17 used dynamical constraints when deriving its original parameters. A vertical comparison is not automatically an independent blind validation. Audit overlapping data and priors before applying the decision rule to real observations.
scope: Distinguishes two chosen mass distributions, not microscopic dark-matter particle identities.
